Hannah —

Thanks again for the walkthrough earlier. As part of FinBank's SIG-lite assessment we're collecting short, verifiable artifacts that demonstrate your Secure SDLC controls end-to-end. Can you provide: 1) one merged PR that shows mandatory code review + approval gating, 2) the corresponding CI pipeline run (log or link) that executed pre-merge checks and a deploy job, 3) evidence of secrets scanning and ephemeral credentials (e.g., pipeline step names or a short log snippet), and 4) confirmation of change-approval ownership for production deploys.

We're aiming to close this sheet by EOD Friday. Small artifacts are fine — short excerpts, links, or zipped proofs. If any of this is restricted, flag it and we'll follow the appropriate NDA/process.

Mike

Attached is an initial zip with three artifacts and short README (secure-dev-evidence-zip-20280203.zip):
- pr-sample-4782.diff: unified diff + top-of-thread showing approvals (2 approvers) and required CI checks. PR title: "feat(auth): rotate token provider v2"
- pipeline-run-20280130.log: redacted CI log for run triggered by the merge (checks, lint, unit tests, secret-scan step). Sensitive tokens removed; step names retained.
- README.txt: mapping document that ties artifacts to SIG/CAIQ control IDs.

Highlights: the PR was created by a feature branch and required at least two approvers and a green CI run before our auto-merge job unblocked. For ephemeral credentials, we use short-lived IAM keys for runners and reference token issuance from our ephemeral vault (ephemeral leases issued for up to 1 hour).

From: Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.ai>

Mike —

Apologies for the slightly fragmented thread; pulling the final pieces together inline to make ingestion easier. Below are the exact snippets and pointers you requested.

--- Ephemeral token issuance (pipeline step) ---
On Fri, Feb 3, 2028 at 15:12:07 -0800 cron-runner@ci.redwood.ai wrote:
> [INFO] step: vault-lease-request
> [INFO] requested role: runner-short-lived
> [INFO] lease_id: vault/lease/ephemeral/ls-5b8f4c1a7c (token prefix: ls-5b8f)
> [INFO] lease_ttl: 3600s

We have redacted any secrets; the lease_id prefix above is sufficient for audit correlation. The pipeline-run-20280130.log in the zip contains the same lines for that run.

--- Change approval ownership ---
Our production deploy job requires an explicit approval step handled by the "prod-deploy-approvers" Google group. Current owners (as of 2028-02-03): hannah@redwood.ai, marissa@redwood.ai, ops-oncall@redwood.ai. The approval enforcement is encoded in our deploy pipeline (policy snippet):
> require_group("prod-deploy-approvers");
and enforced via our CI gate which rejects merges unless the approval bit is set. We've also attached a short policy excerpt in the README inside the zip.

--- PR evidence ---
The attached pr-sample-4782.diff includes the merge commit header and approval thread. Merge commit SHA: a3f9c4d2 (included in diff header).

If you'd like, we can add a notarized timestamp (audit log extract) showing the exact approval action timestamps — that requires a short access approval on our side (I can provision a shareable artifact). Let me know if the three items above close your card or if you need a timestamped event.

Thanks —
Grace O'Connor
Lead, Build & Release Engineering
Redwood Inference
